subject: Reminder: Payment Due for Your Monthly Subscription
body: Dear valued customer, We hope this email finds you well. We would like to remind you that the payment for your monthly subscription is due in two days. Please ensure that your payment method is up to date to avoid any disruption to your service. If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our service. Best regards, The Subscription Team
